text:
Maya Rao: Heads up — prod /v1/generate is spiking 5xxs and we need a quick mitigation. My proposal: pin traffic to dedicated-pool-2 temporarily and enable a circuit-breaker fallback to the smaller model. Anyone object? @Sam Li @Kevin Park

ops-bot: alert: high 5xx rate on service=api-gateway route=/v1/generate (p50 220ms, 5xx rate 4.2%)

Sam Li: what's the cost/billing impact if we pin to Dedicated? likely higher unit cost but quick fix is fine.

Kevin Park: fine with pin. can we inject a header X-Route-Reason:emergency-1958765432 so we can filter easily in logs and dashboards? also would prefer a small canary (10-30%) before full flip.

Maya Rao: canary makes sense given risk. plan: 30% canary for 5m then ramp to 100% if healthy. I'll run the pin command now.

Maya Rao: ```/bin/rwi route pin --service api-gateway --path /v1/generate --backend dedicated-pool-2 --pct 30 --expires 15m --meta "X-Route-Reason=emergency-1958765432"```

ops-bot: deploy triggered by Maya Rao — route pin (id=rp-974) starting at 2025-11-12T03:10:32Z

Anya Patel: please add an adhoc dashboard filter for meta.X-Route-Reason:emergency-1958765432 and a 5xx-by-backend chart so we can watch regressions.

Sam Li: monitor DedicatedPool2 capacity — it's at ~80% reserved today, we should watch OOM/queue growth.

Kevin Park: rollback playbook if things go bad: 1) `rwi route unpin --id rp-974` 2) `rwi cache purge --path /v1/generate` 3) set fallback header to `X-Fallback-Model=small` and disable canary. Also create an alert if >50% of requests have X-Route-Reason header.

Maya Rao: ack. watching metrics now.

(5m later)

Maya Rao: metrics update — 5xxs down to 0.6%, p95 latency up ~20ms. Canary looks healthy, keeping pinned for the remainder of 15m window.

ops-bot: automated rollback scheduled at 15m for rp-974 unless cancelled.

Sam Li: FYI token consumption increased ~22k in the canary window. tagging finance.

Anya Patel: created dashboard 'emergency-route-emergency-1958765432' and added logs link: https://console.redwood/internal/logs?filter=meta.X-Route-Reason:emergency-1958765432

Kevin Park: after expiry we should codify a short playbook: shorter default expiry, pre-check dedicated capacity, and an automated header count alarm.

Maya Rao: agreed. I'll open a brief doc after we stabilise. For now cancelling scheduled rollback and extending to 45m to smooth traffic.

Maya Rao: ```/bin/rwi route pin extend --id rp-974 --expires 45m```

ops-bot: rp-974 extended to 45m by Maya Rao

(45m later)

Maya Rao: rolling back now as planned — unpinning route.

Maya Rao: ```/bin/rwi route unpin --id rp-974```

ops-bot: rp-974 unpinned by Maya Rao at 2025-11-12T04:40:40Z — status OK

Kevin Park: confirmed dashboards show baseline restored. :thumbsup:

Sam Li: will coordinate with finance to reconcile extra tokens.

Anya Patel: added short playbook note to #eng-platform-playbooks and linked dashboard.

Maya Rao: thanks all — will write up the playbook and pre-check checklist. :heart:
